writeup: Woot has the new Red Carpet Studios Teardrop Yellow hand-blown art glass hummingbird feeder (model R41322, UPC 734896644641) for $12.99. It measures about 4.5 inches long by 4 inches in diameter, with a 5.5-inch hook and a red glass flower port. Schwittay Harmony Market sells the same feeder for $26.95 and shows three in stock, NC Hammock Company has it at $28, and Good Stuff Co. lists it at $29.99 with the matching R41322 SKU and UPC. That is 51 percent below the lowest verified store price and saves about $14. Woot showed only two left, with a limit of ten per customer.
